name: Marin and Anti-coprime Permutation
justification: One satisfying observation (gcd must be 2), two-line formula, exact modular answer.
solution_sketch: gcd > 1 forces every i*p_i even; the n/2 odd positions must all receive even values, which needs n even and pairs odds<->evens. Count = ((n/2)!)^2 mod 998244353; 0 for odd n.
